responsibility: Declares the main public interface to GCC’s language-independent tree IR on top of tree-core.h. It provides the widely used classification/accessor macros and inline predicates for tree codes, declarations, types, expressions, builtins, internal functions, locations, warnings, and type/constant properties; defines helper abstractions such as code_helper and op_location_t; declares constructors, queries, GC hooks, and utility routines implemented largely in tree.cc; and acts as the umbrella header consumed across front ends and middle-end passes for manipulating GENERIC and tree nodes.
same_name_distinction: Primary public header for manipulating tree nodes: it publishes macros, inline helpers, types, and function declarations used throughout GCC. Unlike tree.cc, it largely declares rather than implements the tree subsystem, and unlike tree.def, it consumes the tree-code definitions instead of enumerating them.
